# Coding Set Up

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
```

# Reading

The clinical data comes from mapping_wsm from the supplementary material.

```{r}
orberg_samples_raw <- read_tsv(file="~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/OrbergMO2024/Metadata/Raw_metadata/meta_samples.tsv")%>%
  filter(grepl("16S", sample_alias))

orberg_outcomes <- read_csv(file = "~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/OrbergMO2024/Metadata/Raw_metadata/meta_clinical4.csv")

orberg_clinical_raw <- read_xlsx("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/OrbergMO2024/Metadata/Raw_metadata/meta_clinical1.xlsx")
```

# Cleaning 

```{r}
orberg <- orberg_samples_raw %>%
  mutate(batch = ifelse(grepl("MO", sample_alias), 
                        "MO", "SJ"))%>%
  select(run_accession, batch, sample_alias, sample_title)%>%
  left_join(orberg_clinical_raw %>%
              select(sample_title = Project_ID,
                     Patient,
                     Center,
                     Day = Time.num,
                     Timepoint,
                     Antibiotic_therapy,
                     Antifungal_therapy,
                     Antiviral_therapy,
                     Prophylaxe,
                     Current_GVHD_Grade=GVHD_012),
            by = "sample_title"
  ) %>%
  left_join(orberg_outcomes,
            by = c("Patient"="Project_ID"))%>%
  mutate(GVHD_Grade = GvHD,
         GVHD = ifelse(GvHD == 0, 0, 1))%>%
  select(-GvHD)
```

```{r}
orbergMO_qiime <- orberg %>%
  filter(batch == "MO")%>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(.x, "missing")))

names(orbergMO_qiime)[1]<- "sample-id"
```

```{r}
write_tsv(orbergMO_qiime, file = "/Users/sophiehuebler/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/OrbergMO2024/Metadata/orbergMO_meta_qiime.tsv")
```
